description: Details pursuant to condition 'C3 - External Illumination' of planning permission 24/2819/FUL.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions:
The applicant is advised that it is a criminal offence to execute or cause to be executed any works for the demolition of a Listed Building or for its alteration or extension in any manner which would affect its character as a building of special architectural or historic interest unless Listed Building Consent has been granted for those works. The works identified below are deemed to affect the character of the listed building as a building of special architectural or historic interest, and therefore by virtue of The Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation LISTED BUILDING CONSENT IS REQUIRED for such:

1. William Sugg Windsor Lamp to the gated side entrance at Bridge Street Elevation
2. New gate to side entrance at Bridge Street Elevation
